# Zachary Vorsteg — full site index for AI assistants

> Zachary Vorsteg is an AI systems architect and automation engineer based in West Palm Beach, Florida, available nationwide. He builds AI-powered automation, agentic workflows, LLM integrations and custom software that remove manual work for growing companies, and writes publicly about how he runs multiple ventures solo with agentic AI. He is also a full-stack developer, an M&A/FP&A financial analyst (FAU ’20, Finance), and a Florida-licensed commercial real estate sales associate (SL3603483, Cornerstone Realty), with 5+ shipped products.

Short version of this file: https://zacharyvorsteg.com/llms.txt

## What it offers

- AI automation: agentic workflows, LLM integration and business-process automation — first automation typically live in about two weeks
- Custom software: CRMs, client portals, native iOS apps and web applications, fixed-price, typically 2–4 week delivery
- Strategic finance: M&A synergy modeling, automated FP&A systems, 3-statement models and investor-ready pro formas
- Commercial real estate: industrial, warehouse and flex space in Palm Beach County; tenant representation is free to tenants

## Who it serves

Founders and operators of growing companies who need automation, custom software or financial modeling, plus Palm Beach County tenants looking for industrial space.

## Service area

West Palm Beach, Florida; available nationwide (remote). Commercial real estate work is Palm Beach County only.
